findings.counterexample: Delete the four fields only from the current artifact payload: actor_process still returns the full live observation; implementation/qualification hashes it, while qualification_proof hashes the smaller persisted body. The hashes differ and the J cold join refuses. Deleting the same fields from the live observation instead violates the required ActorProcessObservation/ProbabilisticWorkerObservation contracts and carrier validation.

implementation/qualification.ts:51-65 consumes ActorProcessCarrierValidation and sets QualificationJudgment.source.observationDigest = hash(exchange.observation).

qualification_proof.ts:613-621 finds the unique artifact for the actual actor/CCall, verifies finalOutput against raw, removes only cCallRef/requestRef/requestDigest, then compares the body hash to source.observationDigest.
The current event-store artifact arm still extends the exact L payload key set with required nativeResultAssessment; it has not retired the four copies.

M3 c_call.ts:2086-2092 still compares all four artifact fields to its lifecycle projection. Recovery :253-257 strips request/call coordinates and feeds the retained full artifact body to validateActorProcessCarrierPair. Both are affected consumers, beyond the hash comparison.
findings.blastRadius: Current-P M2 artifact retirement affects every probabilistic artifact carrier read and the Q23 J/source/artifact join; preserved Construction recovery is also affected. The existing partial keeps artifact copies and fails closed; no source/data-loss or accepted-release regression is demonstrated.

Runtime imports are shared immutable/admit/digest atoms only; imports of Node SpawnOptions and implementation VerifiedProbabilisticResultContractPreimage are type-only. qualification_proof.ts:51 and validator/qualification.ts:32 currently consume ConfiguredActorSelection as a type from the same lower owner.

actor_process.ts:75 imports isAdmittedLeafInvocationPort; leaf_invocation_port.ts:91-94 imports validateActorProcessCarrierPair and prepareActorProcessInvocation: an existing direct runtime cycle. The port loads the installed leaf implementation at :1105-1112 and calls its completion at :790.

It would nevertheless make a pure consumer depend on the execution owner and its existing cycle; the lower contract owner avoids that unnecessary edge.

No actor-specific projection belongs in shared/: the common-library HOW forbids shared importing owner modules. Reuse the existing shared JSON/hash/admission atoms inside the owner; do not add a new framework or barrel.
requiredTransformations: Preserve the full live ActorProcessObservation and existing ActorProcessCarrierValidation; preserve the physical transport result and helper observations.

Specify one typed current-profile durable observation projection in the pure transport contract owner. Its output retains every non-retired observation member, including optional nativeResultAssessment when applicable, identity, input/output/request-related digests, processStatus/processSignal/timeoutClass, counts, tool evidence and artifact digests. Only the four selected durable lifecycle copies are excluded.

The actual current-profile artifact writer and the qualification source-digest producer must consume that same owner definition. The cold proof must compare the same exact durable representation under the artifact’s actual profile, without separately restating a filtering rule.

Keep request/call envelope coordinates distinct from the observation digest, while preserving all existing joins authenticating them. A projection is not admission or authority to ignore malformed/unknown profile input.

Keep the full live probabilistic-result candidate digest and its matching CCall validation unchanged unless an owning relation separately requires a change: probabilistic_result.ts:582-584 and c_call.ts:3824-3835 currently hash the same full live observation. That digest is a different internal carrier relation from QualificationJudgment.source.observationDigest.

Adapt the affected CCall and recovery durable reads to the same profile-owned representation and already-authenticated lifecycle relation. Reuse the existing CCall lifecycle computation; if its typed result must be made available to recovery, expose that existing computation within the owner rather than duplicating timeout/signal derivation or defaulting missing booleans.
ownerRelation.profilePremise: The actor writer has an authenticated currentProfile from the held successor prefix (:1256); the cold reader has the artifact/event profile and native prefix. Qualification completion has its authenticated nativeBasis/predecessorPrefix but its live carrier has no explicit event-profile field. The owner must bind current-P digest semantics through that existing lawful basis/port relation, or explicitly constrain the supported producer to current P. Do not guess profile from model names, optional-field presence, or labels. Exact callable/type shape remains Worker/HOW-owned; no new serialized profile field or new port is selected here.
ownerRelation.physicalCorrection: The author correctly identified required live fields. More precisely, consensus.ts accepts ProbabilisticWorkerObservation at :379/:477, but its actual member reads are transportDigest, finalOutput, disposition and failureClass, not direct timedOut/exitObserved/terminationConfirmed reads. The required physical contract/actor validator is the direct reason to preserve the full live carrier; this review does not overstate the consensus reads.
